## Summary

- What changed?
- Why is it needed?

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] `python -m pip check`
- [ ] Contracts/docs updated when API behavior changed

## RAG consistency checklist

- [ ] Ingestion and retrieval use the same embedding model and dimension
- [ ] Embedding-model/dimension changes include a reindex/migration plan
- [ ] Tenant/ACL filtering is preserved
- [ ] No secrets, local data, generated bytecode, or credentials are committed
